_comment: The engine's own trophies, built into pack/ by package.bat (tools/build_pack.py). A track addon writes the same file for its own trophies and builds them into <its addon>/podium-trophies/. id: the trophy type, "trophy_" and a-z, 0-9 or _, unique. name: shown in the launcher. donor: the stock trophy whose model layout it takes (default trophy_closed_a, which holds the most vertices) and, with height "donor", its height. grip: the stock trophy whose winner's hand pose it gets (default: the donor; "none" for no hand pose, as Monaco's). reference/README.md has the stock sizes. source: an OBJ, or "<game archive>.erp:<model name part>". height: metres, or "grip" (default): the height of the grip trophy, which its hand pose was made for. materials (OBJ only): usemtl name -> a game material path, or your own textures {"colour", "normal", "normal_style": "opengl"|"directx", "surface": "metal"|"plain"|[r,g,b]|PNG}; a usemtl whose MTL has map_Kd gets its own material without an entry. tracks: the track codes it goes to unless the player picks another trophy for them. preview: optional picture for the launcher. copy_from: game archives whose materials the OBJ's game materials name.
